title: PT (Sodium Citrate 3.2 %) Tube
desc: PT Tube (Sodium Citrate 3.2%)is mainly used for the test of blood coagulation mechanism. It is filled with buffered tri-sodium citrate solution, and citrate concentrations of either 0.109 mol/I (3.2%) or 0.129mo1/(3.8%) are available.
